No bank needed. I'm the owner — I'll finance you directly.

1244 Hadaway Ct, Lawrenceville GA 30043 (The Hadaway subdivision)
- 6 beds / 3 baths / 3,650 sqft / 0.29 acre cul-de-sac lot
- Finished basement in-law suite: 2 bedrooms, full bath, kitchen, SEPARATE ENTRANCE
- Hardwood floors, granite kitchen, stone fireplace, 2-car garage

OWNER FINANCE TERMS:
- Price: $580,000
- Down payment: from $35,000 (buyer with full income docs + 640+ credit)
- Monthly: ~$4,190 P&I (30-yr schedule, 8.5% fixed, 5-yr balloon)
- No bank, no lender fees, fast close (7-14 days)

Perfect if: bank denied you, self-employed/1099, need an in-law suite, or want to stop renting. I verify income and credit like a bank would — that's how I can offer terms a bank can't.

I pay the closing attorney. Real recorded transaction (warranty deed + security deed) — you get full title, not a land contract.

Reply here or text: [YOUR PHONE]. Serious buyers only. Showings daily.

objection_handling.response: Recorded transaction — you get the warranty deed day one, I hold a security deed like a bank would. GA attorney closes it, title insurance available, professional loan servicer handles payments and 1098s. You own the home.

Rent Zestimate is $2,999 but this has a separate-entrance basement suite. Rent the suite at $1,100-1,300/mo and your effective cost is below market rent — plus you're building equity, not paying a landlord.
Comps needed bank financing + 30-45 day waits. This is no bank, ~10-day close, and I pay the closing attorney — the premium IS the financing. Also open to negotiating on strong files.
Yes — 5-year balloon exists for exactly that. Refi into conventional when you qualify, or we renegotiate/extend.
Because I underwrite honestly: a buyer with real skin in the game and documented income is the buyer who still owns this house in year five — and whose refinance pays me off. It protects both of us.
